title: 项目任务工作空间语义 · TSK-02

derived_requirements.rule: 每个任务只绑定一个稳定执行工作空间；默认创建新的托管目录，用户显式选择既有目录时该目录就是实际 cwd，多个任务可以复用同一目录且会话仍相互独立。

causal_probe_plan.given: the isolated task has no pre-existing workspace binding and baseline evidence is captured
causal_probe_plan.when: perform TSK-02 exactly once and retain task, run and workspace identities
causal_probe_plan.then: 每个任务只绑定一个稳定执行工作空间；默认创建新的托管目录，用户显式选择既有目录时该目录就是实际 cwd，多个任务可以复用同一目录且会话仍相互独立。

causal_probe_plan.failure_if: the result is absent, contradicted, pre-existing or bound to a different workspace identity
